title: Numbers up to 100!
summary: Practise English numbers up to 100 with simple, fun activities.
keyIdeas: The whole tens from 20 to 90 end in -ty, such as twenty (20) and thirty (30).
Join a ten and a one to write numbers such as forty-two (42).

activities.prompt: Match each number with its English word.
activities.explanation: Ten is 10, twenty is 20, thirty is 30 and forty is 40.
Twenty is 20 and five is 5, so twenty-five is 25.
Fifty is the English word for 50.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct word.
activities.explanation: 60 is sixty. Sixteen is 16 and six is 6.
activities.hint: The whole tens from 20 to 90 end in -ty.

activities.prompt: Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest.
activities.explanation: The order is twenty (20), thirty (30), forty (40), fifty (50).

activities.prompt: Sort the numbers by their word endings.
activities.explanation: The numbers from 13 to 19 end in -teen. The whole tens from 20 to 90 end in -ty.

activities.prompt: Omar has 30 stickers. Aisha gives him 10 more stickers. How many stickers does Omar have now?
activities.explanation: 30 + 10 = 40. The English word for 40 is forty.

activities.prompt: Match each number with its English word.
activities.explanation: Seventy is 70, eighty is 80, ninety is 90 and one hundred is 100.

activities.prompt: Read the text about the classroom and answer the questions.
activities.title: Our Classroom
activities.text: Look at our classroom! We have forty blue pencils. We have fifty yellow books. Hugo counts ninety stars on the wall. We love numbers!

questions.prompt: How many blue pencils are there in the classroom?
questions.explanation: The text says, 'We have forty blue pencils'.

questions.prompt: How many stars does Hugo count on the wall?
questions.explanation: The text says, 'Hugo counts ninety stars on the wall'.

activities.prompt: Choose the words that complete the sequence counting in tens.
activities.explanation: The sequence counts in tens: 70, 80, 90, 100. 100 is one hundred.
